Hi Samantha (and Devon),

Thanks for the productive call today — great to learn more about Acme's search & summarization goals. Quick recap of what we heard:

- Goal: reduce average time-to-insight for customer support agents by surfacing concise summaries and relevant docs during ticket triage.
- Key success criteria: precision of top-3 answers >= 85% on our prompt set, 200ms median generation latency for 512-token responses, integration with your existing vector store.
- Constraints: data residency in US, SOC 2 controls for logs, and a pilot surface limited to the Support product team (~50 agents).

Next steps we suggested on the call:
1) Evaluation kickoff to align on trial plan, success criteria, and prompt set/evals
2) Technical deep dive with your infra/architecture team (KV cache, vector store connector)
3) Set up a short 4-week pilot environment and run a baseline eval.

Would you be available for an "evaluation kickoff" next week to align the plan and schedule the technical deep dive? Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue, Jun 1 10:00–11:00
- Wed, Jun 2 14:00–15:00
- Thu, Jun 3 09:00–10:00

I've attached a one-page trial plan that outlines the proposed scope and deliverables. If any of those windows work, I'll send a calendar invite and loop in our CS lead (Marissa) for the technical/deployment details.

Attachments: redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Thanks,
Connor
